descriptionByLocale.it:
Diventa parte di qualcosa di più grande. Lavorare con più di 2000 specialisti di oltre 100 professioni e permettere alle persone paraplegiche di vivere una vita autodeterminata. Nel campus moderno di Nottwil, vi aspetta un'atmosfera stimolante e una cooperazione interdisciplinare a livello degli occhi. La pastorale della SPZ è sempre stata ecumenicamente compresa e modellata. L'attento accompagnamento e incoraggiamento dei nostri pazienti e dei loro parenti nelle preoccupazioni personali, religiose e spirituali sono i principali compiti della cappellania clinica.

Stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata come cappellano clinico 70% immediatamente o con accordo. Compiti: • Sostegno pastorale e consulenza per i pazienti e i loro parenti • Progettazione e realizzazione di servizi e celebrazioni confessionali ed ecumeniche • Accompagnamento e sostegno al servizio di visita volontaria • Partecipazione a riunioni interdisciplinari • Cooperazione e accordo con il cappellano riformato Requisiti • Studi completi in teologia, introduzione della diocesi di Basilea o educazione equivalente • Presenza del prerequisito per la messa in servizio episcopale (missio canonica) • Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in una parrocchia o in una clinica • Formazione speciale che si qualifica per l'accompagnamento e la consulenza pratica in ospedale e in casa (Clinical pastorale formazione KSA/CPT o formazione equivalente) • Apertura a persone di altre confessioni, religioni, visioni del mondo e culture • Flessibilità, lavoro di squadra, forti capacità di comunicazione con alta autoriflessione • Competenze linguistiche richieste in francese e/o italiano Offriamo: Non solo si aspettano condizioni di lavoro attraenti, ma anche numerosi altri vantaggi. Attendere un lavoro significativo in un ambiente di lavoro moderno, orari di lavoro flessibili e una vasta gamma di ulteriori opportunità di istruzione. Venite a vivere il nostro spirito unico. Maggiori informazioni su parplegie.ch/benefits. Il Centro svizzero per paraplegici di Nottwil è una clinica privata, riconosciuta a livello nazionale e internazionale per la medicina trasversale, posteriore e respiratoria. Come clinica acuta e riabilitativa, il centro offre ai suoi pazienti una cura completa e li sostiene per tutta la vita. La clinica fa parte del Gruppo Svizzero Paraplegico, che fornisce una rete di assistenza globale unica per la riabilitazione olistica delle persone con paraplegia.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of something bigger. Work with more than 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable paraplegic people to live a self-determined life. On the modern campus in Nottwil, an inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level awaits you.

The pastoral care of the SPZ has always been ecumenically understood and shaped. The attentive accompaniment and encouragement of our patients and their relatives in personal, religious and spiritual concerns are the main tasks of the clinic chaplainship.

We are looking for a committed personality as a clinic chaplain 70% immediately or by agreement. Tasks: • Pastoral support and advice for patients and their relatives • Design and implementation of confessional and ecumenical services and celebrations • Accompanying and supporting the voluntary visiting service • Participation in interdisciplinary meetings • Cooperation and agreement with the reformed chaplain Requirements • Completed studies in theology, the introduction of the diocese of Basel or an equivalent education • Presence of the prerequisite for episcopal commissioning (missio canonica) • Several years of professional experience in a parish or clinic • Special training that qualifies you for accompanying and consulting practice in the hospital and in the home (Clinical pastoral care training KSA/CPT or equivalent training) • Openness to people from other denominations, religions, worldviews and cultures • Flexibility, teamwork, strong communication skills with high self-reflection • Language skills required in French and/or Italian We offer: You not only expect attractive employment conditions, but also numerous other advantages. Look forward to meaningful work in a modern working environment, flexible working hours and a wide range of further education opportunities. Come and experience our unique spirit. More information on parplegie.ch/benefits. The Swiss Paraplegic Centre in Nottwil is a private, nationally and internationally recognized specialist clinic for cross-sectional, back and respiratory medicine. As an acute and rehabilitation clinic, the centre offers its patients comprehensive care and supports them throughout their lives. The clinic is part of the Swiss Paraplegic Group, which provides a globally unique service network for the holistic rehabilitation of people with paraplegia.

Faites partie de quelque chose de plus grand. Travailler avec plus de 2000 spécialistes de plus de 100 professions et permettre aux personnes paraplégiques de vivre une vie autonome. Sur le campus moderne de Nottwil, une atmosphère inspirante et une coopération interdisciplinaire au niveau des yeux vous attendent.

Le soin pastoral du SPZ a toujours été œcuméniquement compris et façonné. L'accompagnement attentif et l'encouragement de nos patients et de leurs proches dans des préoccupations personnelles, religieuses et spirituelles sont les tâches principales de l'aumônerie clinique.

Nous recherchons une personnalité engagée en tant qu'aumônier de clinique 70 % immédiatement ou d'un commun accord. Tâches : • Soutien et conseils pastoraux pour les patients et leurs proches • Conception et mise en œuvre de services et de célébrations confessionnels et œcuméniques • Accompagner et appuyer le service de visite volontaire • Participation à des réunions interdisciplinaires • Coopération et accord avec l'aumônier réformé Exigences • Études de théologie terminées, introduction du diocèse de Bâle ou enseignement équivalent • Présence de la condition préalable à la commission épiscopale (missio canonica) • Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans une paroisse ou une clinique • Formation spéciale qui vous qualifie pour l'accompagnement et la consultation à l'hôpital et à la maison (formation pastorale clinique KSA/CPT ou formation équivalente) • Ouverture aux personnes d'autres confessions, religions, visions du monde et cultures • Flexibilité, travail d'équipe, compétences de communication fortes avec une forte auto-réflexion • Compétences linguistiques requises en français et/ou en italien Nous offrons: Vous attendez non seulement des conditions d'emploi attrayantes, mais aussi de nombreux autres avantages. Nous attendons avec intérêt un travail significatif dans un environnement de travail moderne, des horaires de travail flexibles et un large éventail de possibilités d'éducation. Venez vivre notre esprit unique. Plus d'informations sur parplegie.ch/bénéfices. Le Centre suisse des paraplégiques de Nottwil est une clinique spécialisée privée, reconnue au niveau national et international pour la médecine transversale, du dos et respiratoire. En tant que clinique d'urgence et de réadaptation, le centre offre à ses patients des soins complets et les soutient tout au long de leur vie. La clinique fait partie du Groupe suisse des paraplégiques, qui fournit un réseau de services unique au monde pour la réadaptation holistique des personnes atteintes de paraplégie.

Il Centro svizzero per paraplegici dispone di 3 sale operatorie altamente specializzate dotate di tecnologia moderna con un focus sulla chirurgia spinale, ortopedia, neurourologia, chirurgia tetrahand, chirurgia plastica, chirurgia viscerale e ENT per pazienti plegici e nonplegici.

Tasks:
The Swiss Paraplegic Center has 3 highly specialized operating rooms equipped with modern technology with a focus on spinal surgery, orthopaedics, neurourology, tetrahand surgery, plastic surgery, visceral surgery and ENT for plegic and nonplegic patients.

• As a student of anesthesia care NDS HF, you carry out anesthesia independently with the help of your pronounced professional knowledge, your technical skills and your high social competence under the delegation of a specialist anesthesia and are responsible for the intensive, continuous perioperative monitoring of patients within the framework of your competences.

Requirements
• Degree as a Dipl. Nursing specialist HF, recognised diploma in nursing DN 2 or AKP

• For foreign nursing diplomas: existing SRC recognition

• Mastery of the German language in word and writing, level C1

• Knowledge of French and Italian is an advantage

• At least 2 years of professional experience in acute care

• sound nursing and medical basic knowledge

• Decision and responsiveness in rapidly changing medical situations

• Resilience, flexibility and a high degree of responsibility

• High social skills in caring for people in extreme situations

• High degree of willingness to learn and self-initiative

• You have the desire to professionalize your knowledge and skills with a postgraduate degree.

We offer:
You not only expect attractive employment conditions, but also numerous other advantages. Look forward to meaningful work in a modern working environment, flexible working hours and a wide range of further education opportunities. Come and experience our unique spirit.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of something bigger. Work with more than 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable paraplegic people to live a self-determined life. On the modern campus in Nottwil, an inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level awaits you.

The service area Social and Peer Counselling provides comprehensive support for the paraplegic in all regions of the country. The consultations take place at our location in Nottwil, partly in clinics, at the clients’ home or by telephone. We advise on questions regarding social insurance, finances, housing situation, employment or personal topics.

To support our Social Work team, we are looking for an empathetic and professionally experienced personality.

These are your tasks

• (psychosocial) counselling and support for people with paraplegia or cross-sectional diagnoses and their relatives

• Clarification of social security entitlements and provision of needs-based support

• Assistance in the preparation and submission of applications to social insurance and foundations

• Participation in securing the economic livelihood of clients

• Accompaniment in challenging life situations and change processes (e.g. professional reorientation, separation, transition to AHV age)

• Promoting the independence and personal responsibility of clients

• Interdisciplinary cooperation with involved bodies and partner organisations

• Writing specialist articles for your own media

This sets you apart

• You have completed training in social work FH/BSC with appropriate professional experience,

• You bring in-depth knowledge in the field of social insurance.

• You design your work flexibly and independently – also in the private setting at your clients at home.

• You like to bring your knowledge and experience into projects.

• Your German is stylish and you appreciate the work in an interdisciplinary team.

Founded in 1980, the Swiss Paraplegic Association (SPV) is the national umbrella organisation of the paraplegic cross-section with around 11,000 members. The approximately 80 permanent employees and 170 employees working as freelancers as well as more than 2,000 volunteers and volunteers are committed to the social, social, political and personal concerns of the members and are committed to their reintegration and to improving the quality of life. Requirements
• You have completed training in social work FH/BSC with appropriate professional experience,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il dolore neuropatico è una condizione di salute secondaria grave e debilitante dopo la lesione del midollo spinale (SCI). Probabilmente comporta interazioni cerebrali-spinali anormali, tra cui ipereccitabilità spinale e modulazione del dolore alterata nel cervello, ma le prove negli esseri umani sono ancora mancanti a causa della mancanza di protocolli di imaging per misurare l'attività del midollo spinale. In questo studio multicentro (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), studieremo il dolore neuropatico in SCI utilizzando cervello e midollo spinale fMRI. Dopo aver istituito e convalidato un nuovo protocollo fMRI del cavo lumbosacrale attraverso i due centri, valuteremo la sensibilizzazione spinale e l'attività cerebrale anormale legata al dolore neuropatico nelle persone con SCI. descriptionByLocale.en:
Neuropathic pain is a major, debilitating secondary health condition after spinal cord injury (SCI). It likely involves abnormal brain–spinal interactions, including spinal hyperexcitability and altered pain modulation in the brain, but evidence in humans is still missing due to the lack of imaging protocols to measure spinal cord activity.

In this multicentre study (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), we will investigate neuropathic pain in SCI using brain and spinal cord fMRI. After setting up and validating a novel lumbosacral cord fMRI protocol across the two centres, we will assess spinal sensitisation and abnormal brain activity linked to neuropathic pain in individuals with SCI. As part of the PhD thesis, the student is expected to take an active role in all the aspects of the project, including study conceptualization and design, preparation of the ethical application, data collection and analysis, and publication of the results. Aufgaben: • Contribution to study conceptualization and design • Writing and submission of study documents for approval by ethics committees or authorities • Enrolment of study participants, data collection, analysis and interpretation • Writing and submission of publications in high impact, peer-reviewed journals • Presentation of research findings at national and international conferences Anforderungen: • Master degree in neuroscience, psychology, biology, biomedical engineering or similar, acceptable for matriculation at a Swiss University (Bologna compatible) • Interest in neuroimaging methods, with particular focus on functional MRI • Knowledge in Matlab and/or RStudio • Willingness to work with patients in clinical settings • Proactive, good communication skills and attitude to team-work • Excellent knowledge in both German and English, mother tongue German is preferred • Willingness to travel regularly between Zurich and Nottwil (Lucerne) Wir bieten: You can expect attractive employment conditions as well as numerous other advantages. SPF is an university research institution recognized and promoted by the Swiss federal government and the cantons and an active link to academic and industrial research and development at the national and international levels.

Peer Counselor at Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe offers the opportunity to actively contribute to the support and inclusion of individuals with motor disabilities. In this role, you will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team to provide expert peer counseling and support based on personal experiences to community members.

The position requires a deep understanding of the challenges and needs of individuals with motor disabilities, as well as strong communication skills and empathy. You will be responsible for organizing counseling sessions, providing individual support, and participating in projects that promote autonomy and quality of life.

Core Values:
- Empathy and Understanding: Ability to comprehend and address the needs of individuals with disabilities.
- Professional Competence: Solid knowledge of disability-related themes, particularly motor disabilities.
- Collaboration: Work effectively in an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

This role is ideal for those who wish to combine personal experience with professional expertise to make a tangible difference in the lives of individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information:
- This role is part of the inclusion and support project of Schweizer Paraplegiker-Gruppe.
- You will work closely with a team of professionals and volunteers.

Come parte della cura olistica e permanente dei nostri pazienti, i nostri medici qualificati da una vasta gamma di discipline si impegnano quotidianamente con un sacco di sangue di cuore. A seconda delle condizioni e degli interessi, c'è la possibilità di collaborare in progetti di ricerca o
• Compiti nella cura e nella formazione dei medici assistenti. Invia la tua richiesta

I nostri ergo- e fisioterapisti lavorano in squadre interprofessionali. Dopo un'attenta introduzione al tema della paraplegiologia, trattano pazienti paraplegici e tetraplegici in tutte le fasi di trattamento (acuto, riabilitazione, vita) e pazienti con problemi di schiena o malattie neurologiche con sintomi di sezione trasversale come guillain barré, sclerosi multipla, sclerosi laterale di amyotrophe e sciolto nella sindrome. Invia la tua richiesta

Specialisti IT nel Centro svizzero per paraplegici L'area dell'informatica garantisce servizi informatici affidabili e orientati al futuro per l'intero Gruppo Paraplegic. I nostri partner commerciali, i responsabili delle applicazioni o gli specialisti del sistema, così come i nostri specialisti ICT competenti nell'assistenza clienti contribuiscono a rendere le soluzioni digitali efficienti e sostenibili. Invia la tua richiesta

Consigliere per le comunicazioni supportate o gli aiuti elettronici alla comunicazione attiva I nostri consulenti consigliano e forniscono supporto ai nostri clienti e al loro ambiente in loco per garantire una fornitura su misura nel campo della comunicazione. Essi portano la formazione nel campo sociale (ad esempio l'istruzione sociale, ecc.). Nel consultare strumenti elettronici, l'attenzione è rivolta alla fornitura sostenibile di strumenti elettronici, adattamenti informatici e controllo ambientale. La base per questo è un'istruzione tecnica di base (electronist*in, informatico*in, elettricista*in) o una formazione sociale di base (FaBe, FaGe) con buone competenze tecniche. I nostri consulenti sono in movimento in tutta la Svizzera. Invia la tua richiesta

Allenamenti a SIRMED Gli istruttori di SIRMED informano nel campo della medicina d'emergenza e di soccorso, sia nella formazione professionale di dipl. Soccorso facilitatore HF, nella formazione di specialisti o nel campo del primo soccorso. Hanno completato la formazione come dipl. Assistenti di soccorso*in HF e una formazione pedagogica nella misura di almeno un istruttore di certificato SVEB*in o sono esperti dipl. Professionisti HF/FH con esperienza in medicina acuta o di emergenza e qualifiche educative. Invia la tua richiesta

Il Gruppo svizzero paraplegico è una delle più grandi organizzazioni non profit in Svizzera. Sosteniamo le persone paralizzate trasversalmente con una rete elettrica unica olistica e mondiale – dal sito di incidente o dalla diagnosi relativa alle malattie, per tutta la vita.

I 2000 grandi compagni di squadra, tra cui circa 80 studenti, che lavorano presso la nostra sede a Nottwil (LU) e nei nostri siti esterni ogni giorno con un sacco di sangue cuore per la visione comune.
